device.board: 0E020A00 (bootloader version "M3612 1.0.4", HDCPKey "Demo M3612", 8 MB SPI flash, single-CPU ALi M3612 / S3811 platform)

device.demod: ALi S3501 DVB-S2 on SCB0 at I2C 0x33
device.tuner: Airoha AV2012 DVB-S2 on SCB0 at I2C 0x65

source.note: Archive AMIKO_HD8140_Galaxy_1.5.52_by Dekolte.rar from the Amiko / Amiko HD directory on satedu.cba.pl; fetched 2026-11-02.

simulator.note: Boots as the single-CPU M3801 family (chips/m3801.py, run_dump_hd8140_m3612_app_starts.py, run_dump_hd8140_m3612_capture_screen.py): the "M3612 1.0.4" bootloader prints "APP  init ok / bl_panel_init! / -->>ch455!!", writes " ON " to the CH455 panel on GPIO 31 / 9, verifies and unpacks maincode(AV) ("0E020A001552") to 0x80000200, and enters the application (CP0 EBase 0x80002000).  With the ALi S3501 DVB-S2 demodulator attached at I2C 0x33 on SCB0 (and Airoha AV2012 tuner at 0x65), nim S3501 attach succeeds, the application updates the CH455 front panel to "-ON-", populates userdb(64+64) at 0x73FF80, and enables GMA layer 0 to display its 30-colour 1280x720 ARGB8888 OSD dialog (9 GE commands).

desc: Amiko HD8140 (System ID 0E020A00) Galaxy firmware v1.5.52 by Dekolte (2012-07-10) on an 8 MB SPI flash for the single-CPU ALi M3612 (S3811 DVB-S2 variant) Full HD satellite receiver.

Pairs the single-CPU M3801/S3811 SoC architecture with an external ALi S3501 DVB-S2 demodulator at I2C 0x33 and Airoha AV2012 tuner at I2C 0x65 on SCB0, a CH455 4-digit LED panel on GPIO 31 / 9 (" ON " -> "-ON-"), and the 60-key 0x60xx remote control table ("necfirst" coding).
